text:
Nina Torres: quick heads-up — SI partner "BlueHarbor" is blocked on private-link + KMS for their gov-cloud PoC. asking for an architecture review + ops escalation.
Samir Kulkarni: what exactly is blocked?
Nina Torres: image pulls succeed from marketplace, but runtime cannot reach control-plane endpoints: TLS handshake timeout/refused. customer security won't open 0.0.0.0:443 outbound.
Devon Park: we can't offer a single egress IP, but can provide a small set of egress prefixes and a cert fingerprint for allowlisting. propose: 35.210.24.0/22, 34.72.128.0/23, 35.196.40.0/24; cert thumbprint: DD:EE:FF:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:01
Asha Rao: also ask partner to capture a short tcpdump and proxy logs when they attempt handshake — helps validate SNI/ALPN and middleboxes. I'll draft a 1‑page runbook checklist.
DeployBot: INC-3925 created — priority=P2, owners=eng-platform, partnerships. <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-3925|INC-3925>
Samir Kulkarni: if they absolutely cannot open outbound 443 we can offer a Private Relay pattern (customer-hosted relay that tunnels to control-plane). I can assemble a PoC Docker image + minimal config guide in ~36h.
Nina Torres: can we schedule a 30m triage tomorrow to go over runbook and who does what? customer is asking for go/no-go by next Tue.
Devon Park: calendar hold accepted — 2026-03-26 10:00 PT with BlueHarbor eng + security lead + Samir + me. invite sent.
Contracts: note — if we provide a signed key or host-signed artifacts (KMS integration, module signing) we need a consent form/SLA addendum. I'll draft and circulate.
Asha Rao: dropping runbook draft now: <link.internal/runbooks/blueharbor-allowlist-check.pdf>. includes whitelist entries, tcpdump commands, cert check, and relay fallback steps. feedback welcome.
Samir Kulkarni: after triage I'll post the relay Docker image link and a short deploy snippet (docker run + env vars) and a checklist for smoke tests.
Devon Park: marketing flagged joint announcement hold until PoC netchecks pass. mentioning here so partners know timeline gating.
Nina Torres: thanks all — we'll reconvene after the triage. please add pre-reads or logs into the incident ticket.
Asha Rao: :white_check_mark: will update the runbook with any new items post-call.
Samir Kulkarni: noted, will loop in eng-oncall if we see TLS middlebox failures.
Nina Torres: closing thread for now, will reopen if new blockers arise.
